title: Attribute
description: The third backbone node of TRC's descent path -> object -> attribute -> file (mirroring voidmath's cell -> fiber -> presheaf -> sheaf). Statting a path posits its POSIX attributes as charges on the object's fiber; per the README the attribute node corresponds to voidmath's presheaf at the scott-continuous/posit regime. Minimal type-witness for the node; its full structural content is the voidmath presheaf it carries, whose on-disk derivation is a separate task.
